title: Output definition
description: One controllable output built from one or more board channels. Used in config (server to device) and echoed in info (device to server, with caps).

channels.description: Role to board channel id. Roles per kind: white {w}; cct {warm, cool}; rgb {r, g, b}; rgbw {r, g, b, w}; rgbcct {r, g, b, warm, cool}; argb {data}; relay {coil}; solenoid {coil}; motion {in}.

caps.description: Set by the device in info. Ignored in config.

cct_range.description: Kelvin of the warm and cool channels.

curve.description: Perceived level to duty mapping. cie = CIE 1931 lightness.

min_duty.description: Duty fraction used for the lowest non-zero level, for LEDs that don't light below it.

max_level.description: Hard cap applied on the device (thermal or power budget).

pixels.description: argb only: pixels in use, at most the channel's pixel count.

power_on.description: State at boot before the server is reached.

max_on_ms.description: solenoid only: firmware hard limit for a pulse.
